Name: Undertale Style Voices - VoxBox Pack
Author: plasmoasis
Description:
[size=3]Adds unique voice effects in the style of Undertale and Deltarune using VoxBox.[/size]


[b][size=4]There are two options in the config:[/size][/b]
[size=3][b][i]Fixed:[/i][/b] Delay set to 50ms.
[i][b]Random: [/b][/i]Delay randomized from 30, 31, 50, 51, 100, 125.[/size]


[size=3]
[b]REQUIRES [/b][url=https://github.com/ichortower/VoxBox/releases/tag/0.8.0-beta]VOXBOX 0.8.0
[/url][b]Simply place in Mods folder.[/b]

[b]Not compatible with NPC replacements AFAIK[/b]
[/size]
[i]
[/i]I plan on adding custom NPC’s soon!!
